children: signed an agreement on Saturday to sell its cement unit, CSN Cimentos, to China's Huaxin
, local newspaper Valor reported, saying the deal values the business at 12.7 billion reais ($2.31 billion), including debt.
CSN did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment.
The reported valuation had already been disclosed by CSN when it announced in late October that it had entered into a 10-day exclusivity agreement with Huaxin aimed at finalizing the transaction
The sale forms part of a broader divestment plan unveiled by CSN earlier this year as the company seeks to reduce debt
CSN previously said Huaxin submitted the most attractive bid for CSN Cimentos in a competitive process launched in March 2026
